title: The open unit cube in Euclid k has Lebesgue measure 1
statement: For every k ∈ ℕ, the open unit cube Q₁ := {y ∈ Euclid k : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i ∈ Fin k} in Euclid k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) has Lebesgue measure volume(Q₁) = 1 (as an element of [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ k : ℕ, volume {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} = 1
